title: Currency Exchange Deal
scenario: A street exchanger offers a rate far better than official offices.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Currency Exchange Deal: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Too-good cash exchange rates often involve counterfeit or short-changing.
